recovery_rule: Recovery is additive and never erases or relabels a failed witness.

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: first 225-line activation projection truncated before EOF
combined authorization and roster projection truncated
x1_startup_failures.recovery: read each required file separately in bounded chunks

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: first broad worktree projection returned no attributable result
x1_startup_failures.recovery: use literal branch and path probes

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: second worktree projection exceeded its bounded output
metadata-key inspection piped directly from foreach and hit a parser error
x1_startup_failures.recovery: materialize the row array before piping

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: Windows wildcard literal paths were rejected
x1_startup_failures.recovery: use literal directories plus explicit include filters
request one bounded recent turn without outputs

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: second source-task reread still included a large preview and truncated
x1_startup_failures.recovery: use only the surfaced exact receipt path

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: canonical receipt projection guessed absent convenience keys
x1_startup_failures.recovery: inspect actual receipt keys before scalar projection

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: receipt scalar projection treated numeric fields as arrays
x1_startup_failures.recovery: read observed numeric fields without array coercion

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: branch uniqueness preflight grouped a native command inside a PowerShell expression
x1_startup_failures.recovery: run the native command and inspect LASTEXITCODE separately

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: sparse-checkout wrapper crossed its projection window
x1_startup_failures.recovery: inspect persisted sparse patterns and checkout quiescence before retry

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: first x1 selection found the planning overview below its frozen 700-word floor
x1_startup_failures.recovery: expand the generating overview template without weakening the test

x1_startup_failures.failed_witness: first exact staged review treated scanner definitions and rejection assertions as payload hits
x1_startup_failures.recovery: separate exact scanner candidates from confirmed payload findings by source-line disposition

x2_failures.failed_witness: The first skill quick-validation subprocess inherited Windows CP-1252 and stopped on valid UTF-8 Maori-boundary text before skill validation completed.
x2_failures.recovery: Retain the failed witness at zero credit and pin PYTHONUTF8 plus PYTHONIOENCODING only for the bounded validator subprocess before retrying the deterministic build.

x2_failures.failed_witness: The first broad current-tree selection passed twenty-four of twenty-five tests because the frozen x1 planning-only test correctly found the advanced x2 directory.
x2_failures.recovery: Retain the mixed-context failure at zero credit and bind x1 credit to an immutable x1 precommit Git context while keeping current x2 tests at the current tree.

x2_failures.failed_witness: The first immutable-context wrapper requested a not-yet-created validation directory as its process working directory, so the process did not start and no action ran.
x2_failures.recovery: Retain the wrapper failure at zero credit; create and materialize the D-first target from the existing owner lane before starting a second process in that directory.

x2_failures.failed_witness: The first plain Git-archive x1 replay passed nine tests but its two Git-reading tests failed because a plain archive has no repository metadata.
x2_failures.recovery: Retain the archive-only failure at zero credit and bind the immutable x1 files to a disposable owner-local Git index with source at HEAD and x1 in the index.
